records.subject: You're in -- let's get Willow Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Willow Labs* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:302e750d]. Zero engagement signals and only 8 days left make unaided activation unlikely, though a small share of quiet Starter accounts self-start.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Willow Labs moving
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Checking in after your first week with Wrenfield. The easiest starting point is a first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with your real work, so it's useful from day one.

Best,
Chidi
